batting.dismissal: c SPD Smith b A Mishra

batting.name: Q de Kock
batting.dismissal: c RR Pant b MP Stoinis

batting.name: SA Yadav
batting.dismissal: c RR Pant b Avesh Khan

batting.name: HH Pandya
batting.dismissal: c SPD Smith b A Mishra

batting.name: RD Chahar
batting.dismissal: c RR Pant b Avesh Khan

batting.name: S Dhawan
batting.dismissal: c KH Pandya b RD Chahar

batting.name: RR Pant
batting.dismissal: c KH Pandya b JJ Bumrah

balls.text: back of a length slower ball on off, Bumrah swings for the hills. The ball drops beside his feet. They cross over for the single
back of a length and slanting into off, Boult leans back and punches a single to mid-off
Slower ball, on a back of a length and around off. Chahar has another leg-side hack, this time he sends an outside edge flying to the right of Pant who snaffles it
Chahar jumps across off, but can only deflect this full-toss to Pant off the pad
length ball outside off, slot ball, Chahar lines up, has a roundhouse swipe at it and sends the ball between deep midwicket and wide long-on
full-toss, angling into middle, flicked to long leg
chops a length ball outside off to deep third man

Jayant shuffles a fair way across off stump, 137ks shorter and following the moving batsman. He aims to scoop it over the keeper's head. He's in no position to do that, so he ends up splicing a return catch
slower ball outside off, 117.6ks, Jayant swings too early and loses his shape. Beaten outside off
full and homing into middle, Chahar camps back and clips it to deep square leg
short and angling in from outside off, steered to deep third man
full and outside off, sliced down the ground, to the left of Dhawan at long-on
seems like a googly, draws a skittish push to extra-cover's right. That ends a terrific spell from Mishra: 4 for 24
short, slow, spins away, Chahar leans back and glides it through the cover-point region
wide legbreak, slashed to extra-cover
wide yorker, 88.4ks, plunges on Kishan. He jabs his bat down and plays it onto his own stumps. The ball bounces up and flicks the bails. The leg bail is tipped off. Fourth wicket for Mishra
Jayant chops a shorter legbreak to point and scampers across to the other end

nicely flighted on middle, Jayant backs away outside leg, collapses his back knee and drives wide of sweeper. There's a brief mix-up on the second - Kishan stutters, Jayant stops, then takes off. No harm for MI in the end
back of a length and homing in at off, Jayant opens the bat-face and steers this cutter down to deeep third man
slower ball on middle, chipped in front of Hetmyer at midwicket
back of a length and slanting into off, blocked solidly to cover
slower ball outside off, dinked to short third man, where Ashwin fumbles and gives up a single
hip-high short ball on leg stump with fine leg inside the circle. You know the result: helped away to the right of that infielder for four
wide yorker, Kishan carves it to extra-cover
wide of the crease, fired on a back of a length on middle, punched through midwicket for a double
tossed up outside off, sliced away behind point. Avesh chases it hard from short third man and hunts the ball down
wide of the crease. Darted on a back of a length on middle, Jayant clips it through midwicket
skidding through outside off, faster and flatter from Ashwin, squeezed to cover-point region
wide of off again, but Ashwin shortens his length outside off, spins away, dabbed to short third man
yes he does, pumping Ashwin straight of wide long-off. Tossed up wide of off, Kishan reaches out for the ball and swishes down the ground
back of a length and darted into the stumps, punched down to long-on. Good outing for DC's sixth-bowling option
Kishan stretches out, stabs this middle-stump delivery to the right of Lalit. He searches for a single, it isn't there, so he undoes his steps
dragged down on off stump, pulled off the back foot to deep midwicket
floats a middle-stump full-toss, chipped to deep midwicket
flatter and sliding in at off, 101ks, rushes Jayant into the slog-sweep. Hauled to long-on instead
punched down to long-on for one
chipped in the air...but does not carry to Ashwin diving forward from midwicket. Seam-up length ball from Stoinis, but it does not come onto the bat
short and Stoinis takes it away from Kishan's swinging arc. Forced to sweeper cover off the back foot
cutter on middle, punched down to Smith at long-on
back of a length and outside off, run away towards point
too full, too straight, another attempted cutter, Jayant tickles it away fine of long leg for four
short, wide, cracked away off the back foot to the right of sweeper cover
back of a length and angling into middle, a jabbing punch to long-on ensues
middle-stump yorker, dug out to Hetmyer at extra-cover
flat and quick, spins back into middle, punched to the right of the bowler
short and some width outside off, Kishan frees his arms and lashes it down to long-off
slapped through the line to sweeper cover
full-toss on leg stump, bunted down to long-on off the front foot
tossed up on off, forward and smothered

Mishra takes out Pollard too. This is the slower wrong'un, Pollard wants to review the on-field out decision. Pollard does not pick the variation and is struck on the back pad on the knee-roll. No inside edge/glove involved. The tracker returns umpire's call on middle, enough for the on-field out decision to be upheld. Bail-trimmer
slower wrong'un, wide of off, stabbed in the air but to the right of Mishra
loopy legbreak from Mishra, 76.7ks, Kishan sweeps even before the ball arrives. It brushes his body and trickles to Pant who kicks the ball onto the stumps
much fuller on off, Pollard toe-ends a little drive down to long-on
googly, shaping into middle, Pollard hangs back and blocks it to the leg side
dragged down on middle and leg, comes so very slow off the pitch, hauled away to deep square leg off the back foot
hard-length offbreak, aims for the top of off, played back to the bowler

Krunal plays on. Slider from Lalit, from round the wicket, it keeps coming into the batter. It was short but too close to the body for the cut. Krunal misjudges it and chops it back onto his own stumps. Maiden IPL wicket for Lalit.
length ball on middle, forward and stroked down to long-off
darted just outside off, sliced drive to the left of short extra-cover
heaved from outside off to deep midwicket. Two lefies in the middle, so Pant recalls Lalit into the attack
starts on middle and breaks away just enough to take the outside edge and dribble to point
speared outside off, drilled through the line, but straight to extra-cover off the front foot
back of a length on middle and leg, another slider, blocked to the leg side off the back foot
full and sliding into middle, knocked away more confidently through midwicket off the front foot
prodded into the leg side
fuller and sliding in, prodded back to the bowler

Mishra has Pandya holing out to Smith as well. He loops another legbreak up at 79.7ks, this is an off-stump delivery or rather tossed up just outside off. Pandya can't quite get underneath it. He still backs himself to clear long-on. No dice. Mishra's double-strike has tipped it DC's way
tossed up slower and spinning into middle, forward and patted down to long-on

Rohit dashes out of the crease, Mishra is wary of this as he holds this legbreak back outside off. Dangled up delightfully at only 79ks, Mishra takes it away from the advancing batsman. Rohit has to reach out for the ball, so he drags it off the bottom hand to long-on. Fine bowling from Mishra - he wins the match-up vs Rohit again
flatter ad quicker, defended on off stump
short and attached with width outside off, Rohit chucks his hands at the ball and slices it in the air between short third man and point
hauls a slog-sweep to the right of deep midwicket. Slower wrong'un, lands on middle, heaved off the inner half wide of Shaw, who fumbles in the deep
back of a length and speared outside off at 97.3ks, Kishan stands tall and forces it straight to Smith at extra-cover. Decent, defensive over from Lalit
length-ball offbreak, worked through midwicket with the spin
short, wide, there's a man at point to stop this back-foot cut
faster on off, this fuller delivery is knocked down the ground to long-on
short, wide, scythed straight to Smith at extra-cover
pushed through outside off, this non-turner is eased to sweeper cover off the front foot

on-pace back-of-a-length delivery that slants in from over the wicket. Surya aims to tap it down to deep third man. He deliberately opens the bat-face, but this ball is closer to his body. He can only guide it into the gloves of Pant. Big breakthrough for DC after the time-out
sliced over point. Slower cutter outside off, Rohit searches for the cover drive, instead he slices it squarer
dug in short, and angling into the body of Rohit. He swivels on the back foot and pummels a pull over square leg. Not high enough or quick enough to trouble Rohit
slower ball, full and outside off, Rohit delays the drive and pushes it along the ground to extra-cover
back of a length and shoved down the leg side, tickled away fine past the diving keeper for four
back of a length and holds its line outside off, helped away to deep third man
Rohit uses his feet, Mishra holds this googly back. Inside-edged into the leg side
back of a length and sliding into middle and leg, Surya stands tall and punches away to the right of midwicket
speared down the leg side, Surya was waiting for it, rolls out the sweep, and gets it away from Ashwin at short fine leg
looped up on off, really full from Mishra. But Surya jumps outside leg, gets underneath length and laces it inside-out over extra-cover. Sublime ball-striking
back of a length and outside off, forced through the line to extra-cover. Quick slider from Mishra
down the track and chips a legbreak down to long-off after checking his drive
picked away to Hetmyer at deep midwicket
full on middle, lands in the slot, Rohit backs away outside leg, manufactures swinging room. Shanked over Rabada's head for a massive six
back of a length and skidding through outside off, hint of extra bounce, as the ball climbs over the bat. Rohit searches for the dab to third man and misses
gets on top of a back-of-a-length delivery outside off. Punches through the line and finds the gap at cover. Lalit chases and hauls the ball into play
edged, but there's no slip again to gobble this. Back of a length and straightens away at 141.5ks, replays indicate Surya opens the bat-face and dabs it fine of square third man
Suryakumar gets on top of this short ball outside off, and forces it to cover-point
Rohit slinks around the crease, Ashwin fires another sider on middle or rather the carrom ball. The bottom hand is yanked off the bat once again, but Rohit still pumps it over extra-cover for six
down the track, Ashwin drags his length back outside off and hikes his pace to 97ks, jammed to the covers
pushed through on middle, Rohit drops down to one knee and pings a slog-sweep over backward square leg
stock ball, offbreak, on a length on off, bunted off the front foot to mid-off
wide of the crease, slider at the top of off stump, squirted out to point
Ashwin draws the outside edge with an arm ball that swerves away, but there's nobody at slip to snaffle this. It runs away fine of short third man for four

low full-toss outside off, Rohit loses his shape - his bottom hand flies off the bat - but he still manages to jab it away to the left of short cover and right of sweeper. First boundary of the evening
forced away between short midwicket and mid-on as Stoinis continues to bowl hard-length cutters
back of a length and nipping in, probably an offcutter, defended to point with an open bat-face
short of a length and sliding into off stump, Rohit allows the ball to come on, then opens the face and directs it to short third man
he gets on top of a short ball outside off and punches solidly to sweeper cover
Stonis snags the outside edge of de Kock. Offcutter from Stoinis, bounces and moves away from a crease-bound de Kock. The batter chucks his hands at the ball and snicks it behind to Pant
fired into the pads again, tickled towards short fine leg once again
wide of the crease, another slider on middle and leg, nurdled to the leg side
Ashwin goes wide of the crease, gets this full ball to slide viciously into middle, Rohit does not meet with another sweep, and wears it on the front pad. But this quick fizzer is heading down leg
carrom ball, 95ks, stabbed out to point
on a length and dipping outside off, even though this offbreak doesn't turn. Rohit sweeps, loses his balance, and misses
fired into the thigh pad, diverted away towards short fine leg. De Kock can't get bat on ball
attempted offcutter, back of a length and slides on outside off, hauled away to the left of the leg-side sweeper once again. Another smart sliding save from Hetmyer in the outfield
good length and bends back in sharply from over the wicket, seems to skid off the pitch. Thumps the pad even before Rohit brings his bat down at an angle, height may have been an issue here
pitched further up and angling into off stump, Rohit moves forward and forces this attempted offcutter to the left of the leg-side sweeper. Hetmyer slides and interceps the ball
short, wide of off, angling away further. De Kock reaches out for the ball and carves it to the right of Hetmyer at sweeper cover
on a length and outside off, 126.5ks, Rohit opens the bat-face and dinks it to the right of short third man
back of a length and largely holds its line just a shade outside off, Rohit elects to hang back and push it to cover
full-toss above the waist, this beamer is sliced straight to mid-off. Another no-ball. Delhi topple Mumbai in Chennai
A helmet-less Hetmyer reaches out for this slower, short ball wide of off. Scythed away to the right of sweeper for four
very full on middle, picked off to long leg for one
full-toss on middle and leg, punched to deep midwicket. Hetmyer hares back for the second
Bumrah aims for the wide yorker, comes out as a full-toss, which is heaved to Boult at deep square
Hety now holes out to long-off off the free-hit. Banged in short and outside off at 141ks, Hetmyer flaps it straight to the outfielder. He has to settle with a single. Excellent recovery from Bumrah
pitched up and wide of off, Lalit camps back and drives it hard to long-off. Ooops, the no-ball siren goes off again
full-toss on middle, leading-edged into the covers for one as Hetmyer aims leg side

Lalit holes out to long-on off the free-hit. Very full and wide of off, probably a slower ball, Lalit reaches out for the ball and hauls it in the air. Hety was keen for the second, but is sent back by Lalit
wide yorker from Bumrah, dips sharply as Lalit swishes and misses outside off. The no-ball siren goes off
full and straight, not quite the yorker, whipped to deep midwicket
drilled in the air, but just past the right of Boult who was taking evasive action rather than trying to pluck it out of thin air

De Kock thinks he has Hetmyer nicking behind. Not given out. MI don't have a review left. Slower dipper from Boult, short of the slot, Hetmyer drives but the ball sneaks under his bat. No bat involved, good call from umpire Shamshuddin
Shot, Hety! On-pace delivery from Boult, overpitched and outside off, Hetmyer leans into it and crunnnnnnnnches it over extra-cover
searches for another yorker, comes out as a full-toss, carved to point, tumbling save

inswinging yorker from Boult, has Lalit toppling over and nails the back pad. Not given out lbw. It probably pitched outside leg and swerved in. Pollard asks for a review. Did Lalit nick it? Nope. Yes, it pitched outside leg
Lalit rides the bounce of this short ball outside off and finds a single to deep third man

Krunal runs in from deep fine leg and takes it! Pant sticks his tongue out and walks off. Slower offcutter, on middle, Pant looks to shovel-scoop it away. Instead, he splices it to the outfielder off the top edge. Just like that, Bumrah delivers at the death
slower cutter, full and floated into middle, poked back to Bumrah off an inner edge
low full-toss, angling into the pads, glanced to Chahar at long leg
slower lifter, cuts away from Pant outside off, wide called for height
low full-toss, bending into middle, whisked down to long-on
...and he finally finds the boundary off Bumrah with a top-edged pull. Banged in short and angling into the batter, spliced away over short fine leg
slower-ball bouncer on middle, 115.4ks, pulled away to deep square leg
low full-toss just outside off, kisses the pad and rolls to short third man as Pant doesn't meet with a reverse-scoop/sweep. Okay, Pant seems to have nicked this
muscled away to the left of deep midwicket. On-pace length ball, angling into off, he plants his front leg and heaves it away with all his might
very full and darted outside off, sliced straight to mid-off
jabbed into the covers

a mix-up between the wickets, but Boult can't strike the stumps at the non-striker's end. Back of a length and swerving in to catch the pad. Lalit is more than halfway down the pitch for a risky single, he has to undo his steps. A direct hit from Boult could've got him
length-ball legbreak, bites away and beats the outside edge
starts outside off and spins away further, off-side wide

After giving up a six and four, Chahar has Dhawan holing out to Krunal Pandya at long leg. Legbreak once again from Chahar, this is much fuller and finishing on middle and leg. Dhawan can't quite get underneath the length. He drags a slog-sweep to the outfielder
big-turning legbreak. Back of a length and zips back in from outside off, big bounce to boot. Chahar hits Dhawan on his body
down the track, Dhawan gets too close to the pitch and hastily stabs it to Pollard at midwicket
googly, short and veering away from Dhawan. He rocks back and swipes it flat and hard between long leg and deep midwicket. Oh yes, Dhawan has found a higher gear after the break
pumped over midwicket for six - the first of this innings. Dhawan advances down the track, takes this middle-stump ball, and dumps it over the leg side
full on middle, bunted down towards long-on. Dhawan comes back for the second by the time Jayant himself collects the ball. Just a single. End of a fine spell
flat and quick on middle, Dhawan unfurls a reverse-sweep...but Hardik Pandya dives to his right and stops it with one hand at slip
fullish and just a shade outside off, Dhawan presses forward and drives to point with a slicing motion
swept flat and hard to the left of long leg
Dhawan jumps back and shovels a short offbreak from outside off through midwicket
fuller and spins in sharply from over the wicket to ping the pad, but this seems to be shaping past leg stump
looped up and spins away outside off, Chahar asks Lalit to reach out for this legbreak. Slices to point and sprints to the other end
back of a length and darted into middle, played back to Chahar
tossed up outside off and spins away further to beat the big swing of Lalit
dragged down outside off, hauled away to the left of Anukul Roy, the sub, at deep midwicket
ripping legbreak from Chahar. Starts from outside off and snakes back in viciously to surprise Dhawan and smack him on the glove
whisked away to sweeper cover
anther slower ball slanting away from Dhawan, he pulls too early and misses it outside off
back of a length on middle and cuts away, slower delivery from Bumrah. Dhawan opens the face and plays it to point
shorter and outside off, solidly punched to the left of sweeper cover
full on the pads, picked off to the right of Chahar at long leg
swatted away between long leg and deep mdiwicket. Dhawan goes back to this short ball angling into his body and puts it away in grand style
back of a length and slanting into off, Lalit hauls a pull between long leg and deep midwicket
tossed up and spinning sharply away from Lalit again, he edges a drive it fine of short third man
flat on leg stump, worked to deep square leg
Lalit gets on top of this shorter legbreak outside off and punches a single down to long-off
lobbed up outside off and spins away sharply outside off, zipping past the outside edge. Lalit slashes and does not meet the ball
tossed up slower and higher around off, forward and eased down to long-off
Chahar drags down a googly outside off, Dhawan jumps so very deep in the crease and cracks a pull to the midwicket boundary
on a length and angling away outside off, pushed down to long-off. Dhawan still going at less than a run-a-ball
Dhawan swishes and misses this cutter that sneaks under his bat outside off
short and outside off, dabbed more or less straight to deep third man
on a length and outside off, this cutter is steered fine of Chahar at deep third man for a double

Pollard brings himself on and traps Smith. He decides against a review and walks off. Smith shuffles across off and misses a full ball that shoots low and skids into his front pad in front of middle. It would've crashed into his leg stump. Is this the wicket that would turn the tables on DC?
full and wobbling into middle, knocked to midwicket
fuller and on middle and leg, punched towards deep midwicket
short and sliding into middle, forced between deep midwicket and wide long-on
Smith jumps across off, he knows fine leg is squarer. So he goes low and scoops it away fine of the outfielder. Smith's strike rate is up to 120 now
jabbed back to Pandya off the inner edge
darted just a shade outside off, Smith leans back and pierces the gap between short third man and point with a well-timed cut
on a length and sliding across Dhawan from around the wicket, he opens the face and punches into the gap at covers
flat on middle, clipped to deep midwicket off the back foot
clipped behind square with the spin
back of a length and just outside off, punched with an open-face to sweeper cover's right
sliced in the air but to the right of wide long-off and left of sweeper. Dhawan uses his feet, is beaten in flight, but gets away with the mis-hit
back of a length and spins away into the gloves of de Kock as Dhawan slashes close to his body and misses
shortish and spins away outside off, Dhawan goes back and chops straight to point
deflected off the pads to square leg
slider from Chahal, rushes Dhawan into a hard-handed cut from the stumps, inside-edged past leg stump. Dhawan almost plays on
flighted and dips just outside off, tip and run to cover
down the track and smoothly driven between deep midwicket and wide long-on
back of a length and spinning into middle, Dhawan jumps back and whips it firmly to deep square leg
length-ball legbreak outside off, Smith shapes for the scoop, dinks it into the grille of his helmet. The ball rolls behind square on leg side
back of a length and skidding into middle, clipped to deep midwicket off the back foot
knocked to the covers
arrowed through and spinning in to hit the pad, pitched outside leg stump
Smith steps out to this incoming full ball and chips it with the angle to deep midwicket
chopped from an off-stump line to point for an urgent single
pushed through and angling in from around the wicket, Smith swings at it and inside-edges onto the pad. The ball rolls past the right of keeper and left of short third man
near yorker-length ball outside off, jammed out to mid-off
very full and sliding down the leg side, de Kock fumbles behind the stumps and lets the ball bobble out of his gloves
full and sliding into middle and leg, clipped through square leg for a double
back of a length and finishes on the hips, picked away between deep square and long leg
full on middle, possibly a slower ball, Dhawan delays the drive and pushes the ball up to short cover
back of a length and slanting in at the top of off, Smith drops it to the off side and hares across to the other end
pitched up and angling in from outside off, Bumrah immediately gets his exaggerated angle going, played back to him off the front foot
tucked from a middle-stump line to deep midwicket
tossed up fuller and angling across off, Smith presses forward, clears his front leg and drives it through the line, picking the gap between extra-cover and mid-off
speared outside off, dug out off the inner half to square leg
shorter and just a shade outside off, Smith gets back and flaps it weakly to midwicket
full and straightens along a middle-stump line from around the stumps, bunted to midwicket
fired full on middle, worked quietly through midwicket
pitched up and slanting away outside off, 140.4ks, slices a drive to extra-cover
full and sliding into the pads, Dhawan can't meet with a flick, diverted to square leg
slower ball on leg stump, Smith, having jumped across off, dinks it down to long leg
very full and wide of off, Smith can't quite get underneath the length. Just about digs it out
back of a length and finishes on the hips of Smith, glanced away fine of long leg for four
back of a length and running away outside off with that angle from over the wicket. Smith spars at it and is beaten outside off
slightly short and Dhawan is just in sublime form. Leans back and strokes a cut that bisects cover and point and finds the boundary
length on the stumps, tucked off his pads through square
sharply spinning back into him from outside off, and he punches it away

he's been caught and bowled!. Jayant Yadav, Delhi specialist - who incidentally lives in the city - has struck in his first over. Held this back a bit and Shaw pushed at it with hard hands, got it higher on the bat and the ball popped back to the bowler, who tumbles forward and to his right and gathers it.
he's poked at that one going across him and got a thick edge that goes through the vacant slip region and into the boundary
slog sweep to greet him first up, length ball on middle and whacked to deep midwicket. Not great timing on it, so the fielder is able to run to his left and collect

We might just have had a sensational catch by Hardik Pandya at short cover. Dhawan too early into the flick, the ball holds up in the pitch and he gets a leading edge that pops in the air. The ball seemed to be landing safe but Hardik flew forward and just about got fingertips to the ball. The question is, is it grounded? Hardik's at full stretch airborne, and has got it at the end of his fingers. But the ball might have touched the ground while he was falling forward. Tricky to judge with 2D television replays. Dhawan is safe. The third umpire says not out. Was an incredible effort by Hardik to get to the ball though
beaten. Swing away from the left-hander, pitched on a perfect length and just outside off, drawing him into the drive and zipping away.
corrects his line to be much straighter, nibbling around off stump, punched back to the bowler by getting well behind the line of the ball
cracking shot. Too short and room outside off, and Dhawan climbs into that cut shot and sends it well over point's head and into the boundary
length ball on the stumps, he shuffles inside the line and tucks it to fine leg off his waist
full and straight, hint of shape into him, bat solidly down to meet it straight, back to the bowler
